scheme_name: Capital Investment Subsidy: Information Technology (IT) / Information Technology Enabled Services (ITES) Industries
other_conditions: Must be a new IT/ITES industrial unit
Production must have started on or after 6-11-2002
Application must be submitted within one year from the date of commencement of production for new units, or within one year of completion of expansion/diversification/modernization for existing units
Eligibility category noted in source: large
Eligibility category noted in source: medium
Eligibility category noted in source: small
Eligibility category noted in source: micro
benefits_summary: Provides a 20% subsidy on plant and machinery investments up to ₹20,00,000 for eligible IT/ITES units.
